description: Independent Parkside catalog: models, IAN codes, companies, specifications and documented provenance.
heroText: The independent Parkside tool catalog. Models, specifications and companies in one place, with the sources always within reach.
manifesto: A company in a spare parts catalog is not automatically the manufacturer. Every role here has a source.
search: Search by model, IAN, tool or company…
filterNote: Missing information stays visible. No manufacturer claims based on appearance alone.
emptyText: Try another model or remove a filter.
missingSpecs: Specifications await verification against the manual for this IAN. Numbers in a model name are not treated as technical specifications.
privateRepo: The GitHub repository is private and requires authorized access.
footer: An independent archive, built on documents.
trademark: Not affiliated with Lidl or PARKSIDE. All referenced trademarks belong to their respective owners.
illustrations: Original category illustrations, not product photographs.
methodTitle: The source comes before the label.
methodLead: Officina Index collects Parkside products and documents the companies linked to them. The archive is a work in progress: {count} records, {verified} with a verified declared manufacturer.
manufacturerDefinition: The company named in this role in the manual or declaration of conformity.
importerDefinition: The company identified as responsible for importing the product.
sparesDefinition: The product appears in an official catalog. That relationship does not establish who makes it.
oemDefinition: The physical factory. Listed only when a source identifies it for the exact product.
ianTitle: Every IAN gets its own record.
ianText: A model may have different variants, batches and markets. Records are identified by model and IAN; evidence is not automatically extended to other IANs. The complete IAN suffix is recorded in the evidence when available.
missingText: No manufacturer attribution based on appearance, color or forum rumors. Power supplies and categories derived from catalog titles are editorial classifications; specifications need explicit documentation. Prices and availability are omitted unless checked recently.
contributeText: Add or edit a file in content/products in the repository. Include a manual or other primary source, the IAN and the verification date. Translations live in locales. The build checks required fields, missing translations and duplicate records.
methodLegal: PARKSIDE and Lidl are trademarks of their respective owners. This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by or approved by Lidl. The names identify the products in the catalog. The Officina Index logo and illustrations are original.
translationNote: Translations are provided for browsing the catalog. The linked original documents remain the reference for declarations and safety instructions.
